concept.title: Localization and accessibility
concept.abstract: This chapter explains how DITA enables localization and accessibility through structured content, semantic markup, language tagging, metadata, and content reuse mechanisms. It covers translation optimization using reusable content, accessibility requirements for images, tables, headings, links, and lists, and provides best practices for creating inclusive, standards-compliant documentation that supports global audiences, assistive technologies, and multi-language publishing workflows.
